name: Dragon Cultist

traits.name: Dark Devotion
traits.description: The cultist has advantage on saving throws against being charmed or frightened.

actions.name: Scimitar
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, reach 5 ft., one creature. Hit: 4 (1d6 + 1) slashing damage.

actions.name: Light Crossbow
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +3 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d8 + 1) piercing damage.

tactics: Dragon cultists (found at the Woodland Manse and among Cryovain's would-be worshippers) fight in numbers and flee when their leader falls. Fanatical but weak — dangerous only as a mob or with a stronger ally.
